messages:
mike: Quick pre-merge check — we need a green sweep before cutoff in 1h. Version bump (v2.4.1→v2.4.2) PR still open, changelog missing entry, and flaky test `tests/test_streaming.py::test_resume` keeps timing out on mac-3. Owners, please ping. CI overview: https://builds.redwood.ai/board/1234. cc @anya @kevin

anya: Seeing it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/backend/pull/1987 — I pushed requested change. Need someone to approve changelog blurb: "Fix streaming resume edge-case and bump to v2.4.2"

kevin: Taking flaky. I'll repro locally on mac-3 image. @sophia can you hold the changelog approve until I confirm no behavior change?

sophia: Sure. Will wait. I can do the changelog edit if you want, @anya — small wording tweak: mention 'streaming resume' and 'retry backoff'

kevin: Local run reproduced: timeout at 12s. log snippet:
```
E   TimeoutError: Stream did not resume within 12.004s
.../tests/test_streaming.py:87: TimeoutError
```
Suspect race in the background scheduler. I'll try with extended timeout and add a guard.

deploy-bot: Notifying: scheduled pre-merge sweep will start in 30m. Trigger command: `/ci sweep --tag premerge-1749999999`

mike: :thumbsup: thanks. If you need temporary suppression, we can annotate the test with `@pytest.mark.flaky` and add a ticket to follow up. Prefer to avoid long-lived skips.

kevin: Made a quick fix and pushed branch kevin/streaming-timeout-fix. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/backend/compare/kevin/streaming-timeout-fix. Triggering a targeted run for tests that touched streaming.

ci-bot: Pipeline triggered by kevin/streaming-timeout-fix — job 789 started. Tests: unit, integration-stream, mac-3. See https://builds.redwood.ai/job/789

anya: Just added changelog entry in PR body and squashed. PTAL @sophia @mike

sophia: LGTM on wording. Approving changelog now. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Job 789 passed on linux and integration, mac-3 still flaky — failure in `test_resume`. Rerun recommended.

kevin: Re-ran mac-3 with increased wait, passed 2/3 times. I'm adding a retry loop with exponential backoff. I'll open a follow-up ticket if we still see flakes after a week.

deploy-bot: Sweep started: pre-merge-1749999999 — running full matrix. ETA ~20m.

mike: Awesome. Once kevin's change is in and PR is approved, tagging cutoff. I'll do final merge unless anyone flags.

kevin: PR merged. Changelog and version bump are in main. Cutoff ready from my side.

anya: Thanks — deploying canary to staging later. Ping me if you want me to hold release cutoff.

mike: Merging at :45. Thanks everyone. :tada:
